headline: Approved performance bond for proposed car wash at 10 Manchester Road and final release of $22,885.00 escrow for 5 Mt. Pleasant Street subdivision.
summary: Members approved two escrow items and the minutes of the September 02, 2026 meeting. They also began a workshop on draft zoning changes to meet recent state laws on tiny houses, accessory dwelling units, and commercial districts.
decisions: Approved performance bond #0278138 for the proposed car wash at 10 Manchester Road, $262,928.81, unanimous 8-0.
Approved final release of $22,885.00 cash escrow for the 5 Mt. Pleasant Street subdivision, unanimous 8-0.
Approved the minutes of the September 02, 2026 meeting as written, 7-0 with one abstention.
Left Section 165-126 of the zoning ordinance unchanged for now, because state law governs.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion by Malaby, seconded by Pelletier, to approve Escrow #26-33 as presented. Roll Call Vote: Chase, Wood, Minervini, Mauzy, Appleton, Pelletier, Malaby, and Nelson vote Yes. The motion passed.
Motion by Malaby, seconded by Pelletier, to approve Escrow #26-34 as presented. Roll Call Vote: Chase, Wood, Minervini, Mauzy, Appleton, Pelletier, Malaby, and Nelson vote Yes. The motion passed.

Motion by Malaby, seconded by Pelletier, to approve the minutes of the September 02, 2026 public meeting as written... Roll Call Vote: Chase, Minervini, Mauzy, Appleton, Pelletier, Malaby, and Nelson vote Yes. Wood abstained due to being absent. The motion passed.
Changes to this section will not be made at this time, as the RSA governs.
